description: This file is the entry point for a React frontend application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, along with CSS styles and the main App component. It initializes the React app by rendering the App component into the root DOM element, wrapping it with React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the root.
